# Iris Publishers

> > Iris Publishers is an international open access academic journal publisher specializing in peer-reviewed multidisciplinary scientific and medical research.

Iris Publishers operates a comprehensive platform for academic publishing, managing the complete lifecycle from manuscript submission through peer review to publication. The platform serves a global community of researchers, editors, and editorial boards across multiple scientific disciplines.
